'''Nibber Swoo's cousin''' was the cousin of the [[Rybet/Legends|Rybet]] cabbie [[Nibber Swoo]]. The cousin lived on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] and operated an [[organic disintegrator]] in a funeral home. Criminal organizations regularly paid the cousin to use the disintegrator to dispose of bodies, which allowed him to learn information about Coruscant's criminals that he often passed along to Nibber Swoo [[Gender/Legends|himself]].<ref name="CatCW">''[[Coruscant and the Core Worlds]]''</ref>
